sans.value: Geist, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
sans.comment: Geometric grotesque, per the chosen direction. Geist first (Vercel's, the reference point for this territory), Inter as the fallback that is already installed everywhere. Both carry tabular figures - this product is mostly numbers, and figures that change width as they update look broken.

mono.value: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
mono.comment: Timestamps, IDs, IP addresses, log output. Anything an operator may need to read character by character.

bold.comment: Headlines only. Weight carries hierarchy here, not colour - colour is reserved for status.

tight.comment: Display and the wordmark. Tighter than before: the chosen direction sets the wordmark at noticeably negative tracking.
